## events

Change notifications. After events.subscribe, the server sends JSON-RPC notifications with method "event" on the same connection. Durable events carry a sequence number and are kept in the changes log, so a client that reconnects can resume from the last sequence number it saw.

Callers: `local`, `session`, `device`.

### `events.subscribe`

Start receiving events on this connection. Durable events after sinceSeq are replayed before live events.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sinceSeq` | `int` (optional) | Replay durable events after this sequence number. Omit to receive live events only. |

Result: `Subscription`.

### Type `Subscription`

The state of a new subscription.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `seq` | `int` | The latest durable sequence number when the subscription started. |
| `resync` | `bool` | True when sinceSeq is older than the retained log; the client must refetch all state. |

## log

A hub vault's revision log, for paired devices over the hub's /sync WebSocket (docs/specs/sync-protocol.md). A vault is named by its sync ID. Devices push changed files with the revision they last agreed on; only the hub merges (ADR-0005, ADR-0017). Contents move over /sync/blobs, never in these messages (ADR-0018).

### Enum `PushStatus`

What the hub did with a pushed change.

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `accepted` | Applied as pushed, or already there. |
| `merged` | Merged with changes the device had not seen; file holds the result. |
| `conflicted` | Merged, but hunks both sides changed differently kept the head's side; the pushed content is a conflict revision and the file is flagged. |
| `refused` | Not applied; reason says why. |

### Enum `RefuseReason`

Why the hub refused a pushed change.

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `invalid` | A path the path guard refuses, a malformed hash, or a create or delete that names what it may not. |
| `ignored` | The hub's vault settings ignore the path. |
| `missing` | The hub has no content for the hash: upload it first. |
| `unknown` | The file ID is not a file of this vault. |
| `base` | The base is not a revision of the file, or its hash differs. |
| `collision` | The path differs only by case from another live file's; no longer given, since such a create gets a number. |
| `edited` | A delete of a file that changed since its base: an edit beats a delete. |

### Enum `RevisionOp`

What a revision did to its file.

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `create` | The file's first revision. |
| `put` | New content. |
| `move` | A new path, the same content. |
| `delete` | The file was deleted. |
| `conflict` | Content that lost conflicting hunks to the head; never a head itself. |
| `resolve` | The user cleared the file's conflict flag. |

## note

The notes and attachments in a vault, and what notesd's index knows of them (docs/design/vault.md). A path is vault-relative and slash-separated, as on disk. Every write names the hash of the content it started from, as note.read returns it (ADR-0006): when the file changed since, notesd merges three ways, writes the result and returns it. Only a create has no base.

Callers: `local`.

### `note.list`

The notes in a vault, by path. The filters combine: a note must match every one given.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vaultId` | `int` |  |
| `folder` | `string` (optional) | Only notes in this folder or below it; "/" is the whole vault. |
| `tag` | `string` (optional) | Only notes with this tag or one nested under it (tag/…), ignoring case; a leading '#' is ignored. |
| `property` | `string` (optional) | Only notes whose frontmatter has this key. |
| `value` | `string` (optional) | With property: only notes where the key's value, or an item of its list, equals this, ignoring case. |

Result: `[]NoteEntry`.
Errors: `notFound`, `invalidParams`.

A note's content and what the index found in it.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vaultId` | `int` |  |
| `path` | `string` |  |

Result: `Note`.
Errors: `notFound`.

### `note.search`

Full-text search over titles, aliases, bodies and frontmatter, best match first. Each word matches as a prefix ("plan" finds "planting"), a phrase in double quotes matches as written, and every word or phrase must match. Case and diacritics are ignored. Filters narrow it, each as its own word: path:TEXT (the path contains TEXT), file:TEXT (the file name contains TEXT), tag:#TAG (the note has TAG or a tag nested under it); a filter alone lists matching notes by path.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vaultId` | `int` |  |
| `query` | `string` |  |
| `limit` | `int` (optional) | At most this many; default 20, at most 100. |

Result: `[]SearchHit`.
Errors: `notFound`, `invalidParams`.

### `note.write`

Replace a file's content. base is the hash the writer started from. If the file changed since, notesd merges: frontmatter by key, then the body by line and word (ADR-0005). A base notesd has no version of (pruned after 30 days) is refused with conflict: read again, as is a stale base of a file that is not text, which does not merge. Bytes of the base that are not UTF-8, which note.read showed as U+FFFD, are kept wherever content leaves the words around them as they were (ADR-0014).

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vaultId` | `int` |  |
| `path` | `string` |  |
| `base` | `string` | The hash of the content this write started from. |
| `content` | `string` |  |
| `source` | `VersionSource` (optional) | editor (the default) or agent. |
| `author` | `string` (optional) | Who is writing, for the version list; defaults to the client name given to rpc.hello. |

Result: `WriteResult`.
Errors: `notFound`, `conflict`, `invalidParams`.

### `note.move`

Rename or move a note or attachment, creating missing folders. The file keeps its versions. With updateLinks, every link to it from another note is rewritten to the new path, each as a write.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vaultId` | `int` |  |
| `path` | `string` |  |
| `to` | `string` | The new path; it must not exist. |
| `updateLinks` | `bool` (optional) | Rewrite links to the file, as Obsidian's "Automatically update internal links" does. |

Result: `MoveResult`.
Errors: `notFound`, `conflict`, `invalidParams`.

### `note.delete`

Delete a note or attachment: notesd removes the file, and its versions stay for 30 days, so note.revert can bring it back. base must be its current hash: a file changed since base is not deleted (conflict), because an edit beats a delete (ADR-0005).

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vaultId` | `int` |  |
| `path` | `string` |  |
| `base` | `string` |  |

Result: none (`null`).
Errors: `notFound`, `conflict`.

Rename or move a folder with everything in it, creating missing parents. Each file moves as note.move moves it, keeping its versions; with updateLinks, links to them from notes outside the folder are rewritten.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vaultId` | `int` |  |
| `path` | `string` |  |
| `to` | `string` | The new path; it must not exist. |
| `updateLinks` | `bool` (optional) |  |

Result: `FolderMoveResult`.
Errors: `notFound`, `conflict`, `invalidParams`.

### `note.deleteFolder`

Delete a folder's files, each with the base the caller listed, then the folder when nothing is left in it. A file changed since its base, or not listed, is kept: an edit beats a delete (ADR-0005). Every deleted file's versions stay for note.revert.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vaultId` | `int` |  |
| `path` | `string` |  |
| `files` | `[]FileBase` | The folder's files as the caller listed them. |

Result: `FolderDeleteResult`.
Errors: `notFound`, `invalidParams`.

## rpc

Connection setup. A client calls rpc.hello first on every connection; the server answers any other method with notReady until hello succeeds.

Callers: `local`, `session`, `device`.

### `rpc.hello`

Negotiate the protocol major version. Changes within a major version are additive only.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `protocol` | `int` | Protocol major version the client speaks. |
| `client` | `string` | Client name and version, for logs. |

Result: `Hello`.
Errors: `protocolMismatch`.

### Type `Hello`

Server identity and the negotiated protocol.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `protocol` | `int` | Protocol major version the server speaks. |
| `server` | `string` | Server name and version, for logs. |

## sync

On a device: pairing with hubs and syncing vaults through them (docs/design/sync.md, docs/specs/sync-protocol.md). The device token stays in notesd's secret store and never crosses this API.

Callers: `local`.

### `sync.pair`

Start pairing with the hub at url; approve the code on the hub, then call sync.paired.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | `string` | https://, or http:// on loopback. |
| `name` | `string` (optional) | This device's name on the hub; default the host name. |

Result: `Pairing`.
Errors: `invalidParams`, `unavailable`.

### `sync.paired`

Wait up to 30 seconds for a pairing to be approved or to expire.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pairing` | `string` |  |

Result: `PairResult`.
Errors: `notFound`, `unavailable`.

### `sync.hubs`

The hubs this device paired with.

No params.

Result: `[]SyncHub`.

### `sync.join`

Sync a local vault with a hub vault: files the hub has had at the same path match by hash, others are pushed as creates, and the hub's heads are pulled.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vaultId` | `int` |  |
| `url` | `string` | A paired hub's URL. |
| `name` | `string` | The hub vault's name. |

Result: `SyncStatus`.
Errors: `notFound`, `conflict`, `unavailable`.

### `sync.leave`

Stop syncing a vault and drop its sync state; its files stay.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vaultId` | `int` |  |

Result: none (`null`).
Errors: `notFound`.

### `sync.status`

The synced vaults' states.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vaultId` | `int` (optional) | Only this vault. |

Result: `[]SyncStatus`.
Errors: `notFound`.

### `sync.conflicts`

A synced vault's flagged files.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vaultId` | `int` |  |

Result: `[]SyncConflict`.
Errors: `notFound`, `unavailable`.

### `sync.resolve`

Clear a file's conflict flag on the hub, once the user has merged it by hand or kept it as it is.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vaultId` | `int` |  |
| `path` | `string` |  |

Result: none (`null`).
Errors: `notFound`, `conflict`, `unavailable`.

### `sync.reset`

Leave and join again, with a new replica; files match by hash.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vaultId` | `int` |  |

Result: `SyncStatus`.
Errors: `notFound`, `unavailable`.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vaultId` | `int` |  |

Result: `VerifyReport`.
Errors: `notFound`, `unavailable`.

A hub revision's content, for the merge view: from this device's blob store when it has it, else fetched from the hub (ADR-0018). Content the hub has pruned is notFound (ADR-0019); like note.read, it reads at most 10 MB.

## vault

The vaults this notesd owns: directories of markdown notes (ADR-0003). Registering a vault never writes to it.

Callers: `local`.

### `vault.list`

Every registered vault, by name.

No params.

Result: `[]Vault`.

### `vault.add`

Register a directory as a vault. The path must be absolute and name an existing directory, and no registered vault may contain it or lie inside it.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | Absolute path of the vault directory. |
| `name` | `string` (optional) | Display name; defaults to the directory's base name. |

Result: `Vault`.
Errors: `invalidParams`, `conflict`.

### `vault.remove`

Forget a vault. Its directory and files are untouched.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `int` |  |

Result: none (`null`).
Errors: `notFound`.

### `vault.status`

The state of a vault's index and its scans.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `int` |  |

Result: `ScanStatus`.
Errors: `notFound`.

### `vault.reindex`

Read every file of a vault again and rebuild its index, as if none matched it. File IDs and versions are kept, so nothing is lost. The scan runs in the background; vault.scan events report its progress.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `int` |  |

Result: `ScanStatus`.
Errors: `notFound`.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `int` |  |

Result: `VaultSettings`.
Errors: `notFound`.

### `vault.configure`

Change a vault's settings: each field given is written to .frostnotes/vault.yaml, atomically, keeping the rest of the file; the others keep their values. This is the only method that writes .frostnotes/ (ADR-0021).

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `int` |  |
| `dailyFolder` | `string` (optional) |  |
| `dailyFormat` | `string` (optional) |  |
| `dailyTemplate` | `string` (optional) |  |
| `templateFolder` | `string` (optional) |  |
| `templateDateFormat` | `string` (optional) |  |
| `templateTimeFormat` | `string` (optional) |  |
| `newNoteLocation` | `NewNoteLocation` (optional) |  |
| `newNoteFolder` | `string` (optional) |  |
| `attachmentFolder` | `string` (optional) |  |
| `linkFormat` | `LinkFormat` (optional) |  |
| `wikilinks` | `bool` (optional) |  |
| `updateLinks` | `bool` (optional) |  |
| `ignore` | `[]string` (optional) |  |

Result: `VaultSettings`.

| `idle` | No scan is running; the index holds what the last scan and the watcher found. |
| `scanning` | A scan is running. |
| `failed` | The last scan failed and error says why; the index keeps what it held. |

### Enum `NewNoteLocation`

Where a new note goes (Obsidian's Default location for new notes).

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | The vault's root (Obsidian's default). |
| `current` | The folder of the note open when it is made. |
| `folder` | The folder newNoteFolder names. |

### Enum `LinkFormat`

How a new link names its file (Obsidian's New link format).

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `shortest` | The file's name when that resolves to it, else its path (Obsidian's default). |
| `relative` | Its path from the linking note's folder. |
| `absolute` | Its path from the vault's root. |

### Enum `SettingSource`

Where a setting's value comes from.

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `frostnotes` | The vault's .frostnotes/vault.yaml. |
| `obsidian` | Obsidian's settings in .obsidian/, read while vault.yaml lacks the setting. |
| `default` | Neither has it: Obsidian's default. |
